job.text: A fine Norman doorway, a curious hagioscope, and other points, interesting to archaeologists--also the neatest and prettiest of churchyards--make note-worthy this, the most southerly church in England. A fine old building, not spoiled though "restored." The modern open pews, and a modern memorial pulpit of serpentine, jarred less than might have been expected with the carefully-preserved remains of the past.
